## Changes

### Added
- DNS over HTTPS (More → DNS over HTTPS) now also covers the in-app WebView on Android, macOS, Windows and Linux, so sites your network's DNS blocks load there too.

### Changed
- Home's pull-to-refresh easter egg is now "lalala pipipi", with its song in sync with the animation. A new "Play until finish" setting, shown while the sound is on, keeps it going until the song ends.

### Fixed
- Linux: on NVIDIA graphics, Yoru showed only in the bottom-left quarter of its window, with the rest black and clicks missing. It now fills the window again.
